set -eu
cat > fit_aic.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
d <- read.delim(args[1], header = TRUE, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA"), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
d$PR <- ifelse(d$Efficacy == "PR", 1, 0)
fit <- glm(PR ~ BMI, family = binomial, data = d)
out <- data.frame(metric = "AIC", value = as.numeric(AIC(fit)), n = length(fit$y), k = attr(logLik(fit), "df"))
write.table(out, file = args[2], sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
